enunciado: Declare two int variables a=7 and b=3, show their values, swap them using a helper variable and show them again.
objetivos: Understand that assignment replaces the previous value
Swap two values with a helper variable
pistas: A variable holds a single value at a time.
If you do a = b first, you lose the original value of a.
Store a in tmp, then a = b and finally b = tmp.
